name: Samudragupta
contribution: The second emperor of the Gupta Empire of ancient India.

checks.lead: Samudragupta (Gupta script:  Sa-mu-dra-gu-pta; 318–375) was the second emperor of the Gupta Empire of ancient India. As a son of the Gupta emperor Chandragupta I and the Licchavi princess Kumaradevi, he inherited the kingdom and transformed it into a vast empire through his military campaigns.
